title: A sheaf with a representable surjective etale cover by an algebraic space is an algebraic space
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space G over S and a representable transformation G -> F of sheaves which is surjective and etale, the sheaf F is an algebraic space (source lines 1907-1913). The proof picks a scheme U with a surjective etale morphism U -> G - representable because G is an algebraic space - and composes to obtain a representable, surjective and etale map U -> F, to which the recognition criterion for a sheaf with a representable surjective etale cover applies.
